description.value: Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre is a municipally owned recreation facility operated by the YMCA of Greater Vancouver, offering indoor amenities for all ages. The OSM record indicates the primary sport is swimming, suggesting aquatic facilities are central to the venue. Touring cyclists in the Chilliwack area may find this a useful stop for post-ride recovery, though specific cyclist-oriented services are unconfirmed.
